 How Does Shopee Make Money? Shopee Business Model (2026)
 Business / By 
 Gennaro Cuofano 
 / November 11, 2026 
 Updated November 2026 · reviewed for today In short Shopee makes money mainly from sellers : transaction-based fees, paid advertising and value -added services such as logistics, plus goods it sells itself. In the third quarter of 2026 (to 30 September) Shopee handled US$39.7 billion of GMV , up 23.3%, and earned US$6.1 billion of revenue and US$269.2 million of adjusted EBITDA , its most profitable quarter so far. Shopee was launched in 2015 and belongs to Singapore-based Sea Limited , which also owns Monee (digital finance) and Garena (games).

 How it makes money 
 01 Fees and ads (core marketplace) Sellers pay transaction-based fees and buy ads to rank higher. This core marketplace revenue rose 50.6% to US$4.6 billion in Q3 2026, much faster than GMV. 02 Value-added services Mainly logistics and fulfilment fees. They were flat at US$724.4 million in Q3 2026, against US$723.6 million a year earlier. 03 Goods sold directly Shopee also buys products and sells them itself; these sales of goods were US$746.1 million in Q3 2026, up 44.6%. 04 Scale over the full year In 2025 Shopee handled US$127.4 billion of GMV, up 26.8%, earned US$14.5 billion of marketplace revenue and posted adjusted EBITDA of US$880.6 million, up from US$155.8 million in 2024. What changed in 2025-26 
 AI-driven ads lift monetisation On the Q3 2026 call Sea said sellers are responding to its AI-driven ad solutions : ad-paying sellers rose more than 35%, ad revenue grew more than 55% and the ad take rate improved by more than 80 basis points, year on year.
 Faster, cheaper delivery options Shopee widened delivery from instant (as fast as one hour) to low-cost options. In Indonesia its economical shipping option now carries more than half of orders, at a cost per order more than 20% below the platform average, according to the company.
 Video as a shop window Orders from livestreaming and short-form video grew more than 45% year on year in Q3 2026 and made up more than 25% of physical goods orders in Southeast Asia, Sea said.
 Sea Cloud: AI as a profit centre Sea is starting Sea Cloud to sell the AI infrastructure, model and agent capabilities it built for Shopee, Monee and Garena (fraud detection, customer service, content generation) to other organisations. Management called it a way to turn AI from a cost centre into a profit centre.
 Inside Sea: Shopee and its sister businesses, Q3 2026 
 Shopee (e-commerce) Revenue US$6.1 billion, +41.3% Adjusted EBITDA US$269.2 million, +44.7% Monee (digital finance) Revenue US$1.6 billion, +63.9% Adjusted EBITDA US$298.3 million, +15.5% Garena (games) Revenue US$840.1 million, +28.6% Adjusted EBITDA US$458.2 million, +45.9% Sea Limited (total) Revenue US$8.6 billion, +43.4% Adjusted EBITDA US$931.3 million, +28.9% What it means for you 
 Sellers: budget for ads as a core cost of selling on Shopee, because ads are the fastest-growing fee line.
 Sellers: test fulfilment by Shopee before peak campaigns, when order volumes can be several times normal.
 Brands: plan livestream and short-video content per market, since video now drives a large share of orders in Southeast Asia.
 Investors: track core marketplace revenue against GMV each quarter; the gap shows whether monetisation is still rising.
 Builders: note how Sea plans to sell its in-house AI stack as Sea Cloud; internal AI spend can become a product .
 The Business Engineer lens Shopee is a marketplace whose growth now comes less from more orders than from charging more per order, mostly through AI-targeted ads. The Business Engineer reads Sea as one stack: Shopee brings the traffic, Monee lends against it, and the AI built for both is now offered as a cloud business .

 What drives Shopee’s revenue 
 Sea’s 20-F says it monetises Shopee “mainly by offering sellers paid advertising services, charging transaction-based fees, and charging for certain value -added services, including logistics and fulfillment.” Revenue therefore follows the value of goods sold and the share Shopee takes of it.
 Both rose in 2025: GMV grew 26.8% to $127.4 billion on 13.9 billion gross orders, and Shopee’s take rate rose to 11.4% from 10.8%. In the fourth quarter, core marketplace revenue (fees and ads) grew 50.2% to $3.6 billion.
 How Shopee compares 
 Inside Sea, Shopee is the revenue engine but not the profit engine: its $0.58 billion of 2025 operating income compares with $0.97 billion for Monee (lending and payments) and $1.18 billion for Garena (games), on far smaller revenue.
 Against other marketplaces: Vinted kept about 10% of the €10.8 billion traded on it as revenue in 2025 (calculated by FourWeekMBA), close to Shopee’s 11.4%, although the two measures are defined differently.

 What changed in 2025 
 Shopee swung to an operating profit of $0.58 billion from a loss of $0.14 billion in 2024; its adjusted EBITDA rose to $880.6 million from $155.8 million. Value-added services revenue fell 7.5% in the fourth quarter, to $735.0 million, as more of it was netted against shipping subsidies.

 Commission and Fees 
 Description: Shopee earns revenue by charging commission fees to sellers for each successful sale made through its platform. These fees are typically a percentage of the transaction value and can vary based on the category of the product being sold. In addition to commission fees, Shopee may charge payment processing fees to facilitate transactions, especially for payment methods like credit cards. These commission and payment processing fees constitute a significant source of income for Shopee.
 Sponsored Listings and Advertising 
 Description: Shopee offers sponsored listings and advertising options to sellers and brands looking to increase the visibility of their products. Sellers can pay to have their products featured prominently in search results or within specific product categories. These advertising fees are additional revenue sources for Shopee and provide sellers with a way to enhance their product visibility to potential buyers.
 Value-Added Services 
 Description: Shopee provides value-added services to sellers, such as premium store subscriptions, logistics and fulfillment services, and marketing support. Sellers may pay for these services to improve their online presence, enhance the customer experience, and streamline their operations. Revenue from these value -added services adds to Shopee’s income .
 ShopeePay 
 Description: Shopee has its digital wallet and payment service called ShopeePay . While ShopeePay offers various financial services, including peer-to-peer transfers, bill payments, and mobile top-ups, it also generates revenue through transaction fees, interest on stored balances, and partnerships with financial institutions. Shopee aims to expand its financial services offering to increase revenue in this segment.
 E-commerce Advertising

These partnerships involve promoting products or brands on the Shopee platform, and Shopee earns revenue through advertising fees or revenue-sharing arrangements with advertisers. These advertising collaborations further diversify Shopee’s income streams.

 Background 
 Shopee is a Singaporean multinational tech company focused primarily on eCommerce. Shopee was started by Sea Limited, whose Chairman and CEO Forrest Li also leads the group’s games business , Garena.
 Witnessing the success of similar C2C service Lazada, Li and his associates at Garena decided to branch out from gaming and enter the lucrative SE Asian eCommerce market.
 Shopee was launched in Singapore in 2015 as a socially oriented mobile marketplace for the buying and selling of goods. The platform set about eliminating many of the common issues shoppers have when purchasing items on their smartphones. 
 A secure payment service, Shopee Guarantee , was introduced to help buyers avoid being scammed by sellers. Shopee also incorporated many features more at home on a social media site, including a buyer-sell chat option, newsfeed, and hashtag-based product searches.
 With generous funding from its parent company, Shopee then invested in a distribution service that stores and ships products on the seller’s behalf. 
 Shopee launched in Latin America in 2019; Sea now describes it as a leading e-commerce platform in Brazil.
 In 2020, Shopee became the third most downloaded shopping app in the world .
 Shopee revenue generation 
 Through various fees and commissions, Shopee utilizes the marketplace revenue generation model common to many platforms.
 Following is a look at how the company make s its money.
 Marketplace commission 
 When a seller makes a sale, they must pay Shopee a commission. 
 The exact fee charged is dependent on the product category, the total number of sales, and the location where the sale was made. 
 Transaction fees 
 Advertising 
 To increase product visibility, Shopee sellers can pay to promote their products in product searches, shop searches, or within the platform’s Facebook-esque news feed.
 Shopee uses the CPC model to make money. When a buyer clicks on an advert, the seller pays a small fee to the company. 
 Essentially, the fee depends on the competitiveness of the keyword with the seller willing to pay the most occupying the most visible position. 
 Fulfillment 
 Fulfilled by Shopee (FBS) is the name given to a distribution service allowing sellers to have their goods stored and shipped by Shopee. 
 The fee for this service is on a per-item basis and depends on the size and weight of the item.
 Payment fees 
 Sellers can also opt to accept the ShopeePay digital wallet as a form of payment. When a buyer uses this service, the seller must pay an undisclosed fee to Shopee. 
 Delivery and restaurant commission fees 
 Shopee also operates a food delivery service called ShopeeFood . 
 Again, the rates for using this service are undisclosed. But it can be assumed that Shopee collects an order commission from each participating restaurant and charges consumers a delivery fee.
